set.body:
Source: plan phase 3; review findings with no prior bead.

Problem:
Things that are named compatibility contracts are defined more than once, so they can drift silently.

Scope:
- Canonical JSON printer defined twice: core/codec/VersionedJson.scala:31 and managed/FileJournalControlStore.scala:364 (JournalCodec). If one changes, journal checksums stop matching wire canonicalization. One definition for one contract.
- IdentifierRules duplicated byte-identically in kernel/Identifiers.scala and core/Identifiers.scala, a leftover of the kernel extraction.
- StructuredJson hand-rolls traverse and mapN although the protocol module already depends on cats; the file also needs two separate imports of StructuredJson.* because the helper sits between its users.
- decodeBase64 duplicated in ResultEnvelopeCodec and TaskInvocationCodec; MaximumOutputs = 1024 defined three times.
- Array dispatch script generated twice with identical shape (arrayLaunchScriptBytes and arrayDispatchScript in RegisteredTaskLauncher).

Acceptance: one definition per contract, with the canonical-bytes consolidation covered by a test that would fail if the two printers diverged.
set.title: P7.4: Remove codec-adjacent duplication
